title: Getting Started with Tempo.Reporting.Engine
overview: Tempo.Reporting.Engine executes Tempo report definitions: expression evaluation, parameter resolution, data processing, grouping, fixed-page band layout, snapshot generation, PDF/PNG rendering, and CSV/XLSX export.
notes: The engine is pure .NET and can run server-side or in WebAssembly hosts.
Report Server APIs and embedded Blazor report sources use this package for the actual rendering pipeline.
